items.title: The comparison map on Ext of a two-term complex over the quotient vanishes after a shift
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement asserts the vanishing of the comparison map on first Ext of a two-term complex after shifting by a controlled amount (author lemma at source lines 5450-5467, label lemma-bound-two-term-complex), under an explicit numerical hypothesis on the exponent and under the hypothesis that a certain Ext group is annihilated by the ideal power. The proof (source lines 5469-5545) represents the complex by a two-term complex with a projectivity property for the ideal power, reduces the vanishing to a factorisation statement using the description of maps out of an almost free module, and then verifies that factorisation by constructing a map to the structure sheaf of the closed subscheme and chasing the diagram (proof lines 5520-5545). The reduction to the factorisation and the diagram chase are the content. H2.
